name: smwsprites-shotzo
title: Shotzo
description:
The Shotzo from Kirby, a 16x16 cannon which will point in Mario's direction and shoot bullets at him. It will shoot 3 bullets before making a short pause. It will hurt Mario and can only be killed with shells.

It can fire either standard sprite bullets or cluster sprite bullets. Check the readme and the ASM files for more information.

Originally part of the Kirby Sprite Pack.
